name: Tag Properties
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds a custom list tag view with note counts, clickable results and native Bases filters.
Adds optional multiple properties and combined core tags through GitHub Sponsors.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Settings now end with a More from NoteMods group, where you can turn this tab off or open it again.
tip: Select "Copy bases filter" to use the current tag selection in the advanced filter editor of a base.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Tag Properties is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to browse your notes by topic.
